m: नि-˚नादिन् mfn. sounding, resounding, crying, resonant with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
ifc. causing to sound, playing (a musical instrument), MBh.; Hariv.
a: निनादिन् — a. 1 Sounding, ringing. --2 Causing to sound, playing (as a musical instrument).

m: नि-˚नादित mfn. filled with noise, resonant with (instr.), ib.
नि-˚नादित n. = prec. ib.
a: निनादित — n. Filled with noise, resounding, made to sound. --तं A sound.

a: निनाह्यः — A water-jar to be put into the ground.

m: नि-√ नी P. Ā. -नयति, ˚ते (Subj. aor. -नेषत्), to lead to, carry or bring towards (dat. or loc.), bring or cause to (dat. inf.), RV.; AV. &c.; to incline, bend, BhP.; to pour down, pour out or in TS.; ŚBr.; Yājñ. &c.; to cause to enter, BhP.; to offer as a sacrifice, ib.; to carry out, accomplish, perform, ib.; to spend (time), MW.
a: निनी — {c1c} P. 1 To take near or towards, carry near, bring, fetch; Y. 3. 295. --2 To bend, incline; वक्त्रं निनीय. --3 To pour down. --4 To bring about, accomplish, perform. --5 To spend (time).

m: निनीषा (fr. Desid. of √ 1. नी), desire of bringing or carrying or taking away, MBh.
निनी˚षु mfn. wishing to take or carry or bring or lead to (acc. or acc. with प्रति) or spend (time), MBh.; Kād.; Rājat.

a: निनंक्षु — a. 1 Wishing to die. --2 Wishing to escape or fly away; Bk. 4. 33.

v: tri॰ nazwu micCuH naSa--san--u num । adarSanaM prAptumicCO “avisPavacca vanDUnAM ninaNkzurvikramaM muhuH” BawwiH ।
m: निनङ्क्षु (Desid. of √ 2. नश्), wishing to perish or die, Bhaṭṭ.
नि-√ नद् P. -नदति, to sound, cry out, resound, MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. -नादयति, to cause to sound or resound, fill with noise or cries &c., ib.
a: निनद् — {c1c} P. 1 To sound, shout; R. 5. 75; M. 5. 10; Bk. 6. 117. --2 To resound, echo.

m: नि-नद्ध mfn. (√ नह्) fastened on, tied to (loc.), RV. vi, 75, 5.

s: puM, (ni + nada + “nO gadanadapaWasvanaH .” 3 । 3 । 64 । iti ap .) SabdaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 6 । 22 ॥ (yaTA, devIBAgavate । 3 । 22 । 37 । “SfRvantu tUryyaninadAn kila vAdyamAnAn ॥”)
v: pu॰ ni + nada--BAva ap । 1 Sabde amaraH 2 raTatulyaSabde SabdArTaci॰ । uccacAra ninado'mBasi tasyAH” raGuH ।
m: नि-˚नद m. (n., ChUp. iii, 13, 8) sound, noise, crying, humming, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: निन(ना)दः — 1 Sound, noise; U. 3. 7; उच्चचार निनदोंऽभसि तस्याः R. 9. 73; 11. 15; Rs. 1. 15. --2 Buzzing, humming (of bees &c.). --3 A sound like that of a chariot.

k.v: सत्यं तथ्यमृतं सम्यगमूनि त्रिषु तद्वति। शब्दे निनादनिनदध्वनिध्वानरवस्वनाः॥

m: नि-√ नर्द् P. -नर्दति, to sound, prolong a note in chanting, slur or trill, ṢaḍvBr. (cf. अव-√ नर्द्) : Caus. -नर्दयति, GopBr.
a: निनर्द् — {c1c} P. 1 To sound. --2 To prolong a note (in chanting).

v: pu॰ ni + narda--BAve GaY । vedaSabdasyoccAraRaBede । tatprakAraH ASva॰ SrO॰ 8 । 3 । 9 “tftIye tu pAdezvAdito yadakzaraM tadanudAttIkftya brUyAt । etaduktaM Bavati tftIyezu praTamamAdita ityarTaH । Adito ye dve akzare tayoH pUrvamanudAttaM tasmAt paraM dvitIyam udAttaM yaTA Bavet taTA ninardet nitarAM brUyAdityarTaH । tadevamuccAraRaM ninardaSabdenocyata ityarTaH” nArA॰ “tasyottamAvarjaM tftIyezu nyUNKo ninardaSca” 7 । 119 “tasya sUktasya yAH purastAt prAguttamAyA fcastAsAM tftIyezu pAdezu nyUNKo ninardaSca karttavyaH । uttamApi nyUNKaninardarahitA Sastavyeva” nArA॰ “svarAdiranta okAraScaturninardaH” 11 a॰ tftIyezu pAdezu ninarda uktaH । tezu kasmin pradeSa ityucyate । pAdAnte । svarAdiH svaro vAwipradeSa ityarTaH sa cOkAraScatuzkftvo vaktavyaH sa ninardaH ityucyate” nArA॰ ।
m: नि-नर्द m. a slur or trill, ĀśvŚr.
a: निनर्दः — Prolonging a note in chanting.

m: निनर्त-शत्रु w.r. for निवृत्त-श्˚.
निनर्तिषा f. (√ नृत्) desire of dancing, Hcar.

m: नि-˚नयनीय See स्वधा-निनयनीय.

v: na॰ ni + nI--lyuw । 1 nizpAdane “nABivyAhArayet brahma svaDAninayanAdfte” manuH “ninayanaM nizpAdanam” kullU॰ । 2 parAsecane ca nipUrvakasya nayateH parizekArTatvAt taTAtvam । “varhizi pUrRapAtraM nigayet” ASva॰ gf॰ sU॰ 1 । 10 । 23 “ninayet siYcedityarTaH nArA॰ “ezo'vaBfTaH” 4 sU॰ “yadidaM pUrRapAtraninayanaM ezo'sya karmaRo'vaBfTo Bavati” nArA॰ “udakaM camasaM ninayeyuH” drAhmA॰ sU॰ “ninayeyuH parAsiYceyuH” tARqya॰ brA॰ BA॰
m: नि-नयन ˚यनीय. See नि-नी below.
नि-˚नयन n. pouring down or out, Kauś. (cf. स्वधा-न्˚)
carrying out, performance, MW.
a: निनयनं — 1 Performance. --2 Performing, accomplishing. --3 Pouring out.

m: निन्द् or निद् cl. 1. P. निन्दति, ep. also ˚ते (the form निद् only in 3. pl. pf. निनिदुस्, in the Desid. and in some deriv. See under 1. निद् and निनित्सु below; pf. निनिन्द, MBh.; aor. अनिन्दिषुर्, RV.; निन्दिषत्, AV.; Pot. निन्द्यात्, Up.; fut. निन्दिष्यति, Vop.; निन्दिता, MBh.; ind.p. -निन्द्य, ib.), to blame, censure, revile, despise, ridicule, RV. &c. &c.: Desid. निनित्सति, ˚ते, to wish to blame &c., RV.; ĀśvŚr. [cf. Gk. ὄ-νειδος.]

s: strI, (nindanamiti । nidi + “guroSca halaH .” 3 । 3 । 103 । iti striyAM aH .) apavAdaH । duzkftiH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ nindanam । tatparyyAyaH । avarRaH 2 AkzepaH 3 nirvvAdaH 4 parIvAdaH 5 apavAdaH 6 upakroSaH 7 jugupsA 8 kutsA 9 garhaRam 10 । ityamaraH ॥ garhA 11 kutsanam 12 parivAdaH 13 jugupsanam 14 apakroSaH 15 Bartsanam 16 avavAdaH 17 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ garhaRA 18 DikkriyA 19 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 2 । 200 । “guroryatra parIvAdo nindA vApi pravarttate । karRO tatra piDAtavyO gantavyaM vA tato'nyataH ॥”) harakeSavaBaktAdinindAyAM dozo yaTA, -- “harakeSavayorBaktaM ye ca nindanti pApinaH । BUdevAn brAhmaRAMScEva svagurUMSca pativratAH ॥ yatiBikzukabrahmacArisfzwibIjAn surAMstaTA । pacyante kAlasUtre te yAvaccandradivAkarO ॥ SlezmamUtrapurIzezu Serate te divAniSam । BakzitAH kIwanikarEH SabdaM kurvvanti kAtarAH ॥ ye nindanti ca brahmARaM srazwAraM jagatAM gurum । SivaM surARAM pravaraM durgAM lakzmIM sarasvatIm ॥ sItAYca tulasIM gaNgAM vedAMSca vedamAtaram । vrataM tapasyAM pUjAYca mantraM mantrapradaM gurum ॥ te pacyante'nDakUpe vE cAyuzo'rdDaM viDeraho । BakzitAH sarpasaMGESca SabdaM kurvvanti santatam ॥ yo nindanti hfzIkeSaM devasAmyaM viDAya ca । vizRuBaktipradaYcEva purARaYca SruteH param ॥ rADAM tadaNgajA gopIrbrAhmaRAMSca sadAccitAn । te pacyante'vawe deva ! viDAturAyuzA samam ॥ aDomuKA UrdDvajaNGA sarpasaMGESca vezwitAH । BakzitA vikftAkArEH kIwEH sarpEH samAhftEH ॥ atIvakAtarA BItAH SabdaM kurvvanti santatam । SlezmamUtrapurIzARi DruvaM Bakzanti kzoBitAH ॥ ulkAM dadati ruzwASca tanmuKe yamakiNkarAH । trisanDyaM tarjanaM kftvA kurvvanti daRqatAqanam ॥ kurvvanti mUtrapAnaYca prahArEstfzitA BiyA । tadA kalpAntare srazwuM sfzweSca praTame punaH ॥ tezAM Bavet pratIkAra ityAha kamalodBavaH । paranindA vinASAya svanindA yaSase param ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe । 40 । 41 aH ॥ “vedanindAratAn martyAn devanindAratAMstaTA । dvijanindAratAMScEva manasApi na cintayet ॥ na cAtmAnaM praSaMsedbA paranindAYca varjjayet । vedanindAM devanindAM prayatnena vivarjjayet ॥ yastu devAnfzIMScEva vedaM yA nindati dvijaH । na tasya nizkftirdfzwA SAstrezviha munISvarAH ! ॥ nindayedvE guruM devaM vedaM vA sopabfMhaRam । kalpakowiSataM sAgraM rOrave pacyate naraH ॥ tUzRImAsIta nindAyAM na brUyAt kiYciduttaram । karRO piDAya gantavyaM na cEnAnavalokayet ॥ varjjayedvE parezAntu gfhezu garhaRAM buDaH । na nindedyoginaH sidDAn vratino vA yatIMstaTA ॥ devatAyatanaM prAjYo devAnAmAkftintaTA ॥” iti kOrmme upaviBAge 15 aDyAyaH ॥
v: strI nindi--BAve a । avidyamAnadozABiDAne 1 garhaRe “vedanindAratAn martyAn devanindAratAMstaTA । dvijanindAratAMScEva manasApi na cintayet । na cAtmAnaM praSaMsedvA paranindASca varjayet । vedanindAM devanindAM prayatnena vivarjayet” kOrma pu॰ 15 a॰ । 2 anizwasAGanatvaboDanadvArA viDyarTapraSaMsAvacane ca “na hi nindA nindyaM nindituM pravarttate api tu viDeyaM stotum” nyAya॰ ।

s: strI, (nindayA stutiH .) vyAjastutiH । yaTA, -- “nindAstutiByAM vAcyAByAM gamyatve stutinindayoH .” nindayA stutirgamyatve vyAjena stutiriti ca vyutpattyA vyAjastutiH । iti sAhityadarpaRaH । api ca । “yadi nindanniva stOti vyAjastutirasO matA .” udAharaRam । “tApasenApi rAmeRa jiteyaM BUtaDAriRI । tvayA rAjYApi sEveyaM jitA mABUnmadastava ॥” iti daRqI ॥ “kaTamavanipa ! darpo yanniSAtAsiDArAdalanagalitamUrdDnAM vidbizAM svIkftA SrIH । nanu tava nihatArerapyasO kinna nItA tridivamapagatANgErvallaBA kIrttireBiH ॥ ityAdO nindAstutivapuzA svarUpasya .” iti kAvyaprakASaH ॥

v: tri॰ ninda--kta । 1 garhite 2 Dikkfte jawA॰ “vihitasyAnanuzWAnAt ninditasya ca sevanAt” yAjYa॰ । ninditaYca SAstralokayorgarhitam । tatra SAstre ninditaM SUdrapratigrahAdi lokagarhitamatiBojanAdi । “asvargyaM lokabidvizwaM tasmAt tat parivarjayet” manuH “yadyapi SizwaM lokavirudDaM nAcaraRIyaM nAcaraRIyamiti” mitAkzarADftavacanam ।
m: निन्दित mfn. blamed, censured, abused, defamed, low, despicable, prohibited, forbidden, RV.; Br. &c.
निन्दितृ m. scorner, scoffer, RV.
निन्˚दोपमा f. a comparison which involves reproof, Kāvyād. ii, 30.

m: निन्दु f. a woman bearing a dead child, L.
निन्द्य (or निन्द्य), mfn. = ˚दनीय, RV.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
निन्द्य—ता f. blamableness, disgrace, Mn.
निन्द्य-वेश mfn. (a convent) the entrance into which is faulty, Daś.

नि-˚नृत्ति f. repetition, ŚāṅkhBr.

निनित्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to blame, RV.
निन्व् cl. 1. ˚वति (Dhātup. xv, 81; v.l. सिन्व्), to wet or to attend (prob. a confusion between सेचने and सेवने).
